text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Rose Stakes. The crowd 
expects Daiichi Ruby to continue on the 
royal road and take on the Shuka Sho, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having decided to leave the royal road, 
Daiichi Ruby informs her Trainer that she 
will announce her transition to the sprint 
division after the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First, give everything to the Rose Stakes 
right before her. To mark a brand-new 
start, she takes off running now—!
